cells.gaps: No row holds the policy's text or a link to it from an official site, and none gives an adoption act or a stated period, so it is not established whether the 2004 policy is open or ended. cells.note: Politique nationale des TIC pour le développement 2004: adopted on JICA's 2022 description, with dated targets and a 2022 assessment against some objectives. Stage 3 needs the text public, and an adopted policy whose text nobody has found stops at stage 2, unflagged.
